241	 * 这是有机洞型的来源(TileRunner strength<50 时恒速恒宽 = 直线刀砍)。
242	 */
243	export function digTunnel(
244	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG,
245	  X: number, Y: number, xDir: number, yDir: number,
246	  steps: number, size: number, wet = false,
247	): [number, number] {
248	  let x = Math.max(size + 1, Math.min(st.w - size - 1, X));
249	  let y = Math.max(size + 1, Math.min(st.h - size - 1, Y));
250	  let noiseX = 0, noiseY = 0;
251	  let radius = size;
252	  for (let step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
253	    // (int) 向零截断（cs:79766-79767）：floor 在负小数时多扫一列 → 多耗 dist 骰
254	    const x0 = Math.trunc(x - radius), x1 = Math.floor(x + radius);
255	    const y0 = Math.trunc(y - radius), y1 = Math.floor(y + radius);
256	    for (let ix = x0; ix <= x1; ix++) {
257	      for (let iy = y0; iy <= y1; iy++) {
258	        if (Math.abs(ix - x) + Math.abs(iy - y) < radius * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.005)
259	          && st.inBounds(ix, iy)) {
260	          const i = st.idx(ix, iy);
261	          st.flags[i] = 0; // 原版 active(false) 保留 type（幽灵）——清零分叉拒绝采样
262	          if (wet) { st.liquid[i] = 255; st.liquidType[i] = 1; }
263	        }
264	      }
265	    }
266	    radius += rng.int(-50, 50) * 0.03;
267	    if (radius < size * 0.6) radius = size * 0.6;
268	    if (radius > size * 2) radius = size * 2;
269	    noiseX += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.01;
270	    noiseY += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.01;
271	    noiseX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, noiseX));
272	    noiseY = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, noiseY));
273	    x += (xDir + noiseX) * 0.6;
274	    y += (yDir + noiseY) * 0.6;
275	  }
276	  return [x, y];
277	}
278	
279	function inUndergroundDesert(gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
280	  const ud = gs.undergroundDesert;
281	  return !!ud && x >= ud.x0 && x <= ud.x1 && y >= ud.y0 && y <= ud.y1;
282	}

	public static void PlaceWall(int i, int j, int type, bool mute = false)
	{
		if (i <= 1 || j <= 1 || i >= Main.maxTilesX - 2 || j >= Main.maxTilesY - 2)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (Main.tile[i, j] == null)
		{
			Main.tile[i, j] = new Tile();
		}
		if (Main.tile[i, j].wall == 0)
		{
			Main.tile[i, j].wall = (ushort)type;
			SquareWallFrame(i, j);
			if (!mute)
			{
				SoundEngine.PlaySound(0, i * 16, j * 16);
			}
		}
	}

	public static void WallFrame(int i, int j, bool resetFrame = false)
	{
		if (i <= 0 || j <= 0 || i >= Main.maxTilesX - 1 || j >= Main.maxTilesY - 1 || Main.tile[i, j] == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (Main.tile[i, j].wall >= WallID.Count)
		{
			Main.tile[i, j].wall = 0;
		}
		Tile tile = Main.tile[i, j];
		if (tile.wall == 0)
		{
			tile.wallColor(0);
			tile.ClearWallPaintAndCoating();
			return;
		}
		int num = 0;
		bool flag = Main.ShouldShowInvisibleBlocksAndWalls();
		if (j - 1 >= 0)
		{
			Tile tile2 = Main.tile[i, j - 1];
			if (tile2 != null && (tile2.wall > 0 || (tile2.active() && TileID.Sets.TruncatesWalls[tile2.type])) && (flag || !tile2.invisibleWall()))
			{
				num = 1;
			}
		}
		if (i - 1 >= 0)
		{
			Tile tile2 = Main.tile[i - 1, j];
			if (tile2 != null && (tile2.wall > 0 || (tile2.active() && TileID.Sets.TruncatesWalls[tile2.type])) && (flag || !tile2.invisibleWall()))
			{
				num |= 2;
			}
		}
		if (i + 1 <= Main.maxTilesX - 1)
		{
			Tile tile2 = Main.tile[i + 1, j];
			if (tile2 != null && (tile2.wall > 0 || (tile2.active() && TileID.Sets.TruncatesWalls[tile2.type])) && (flag || !tile2.invisibleWall()))
			{
				num |= 4;
			}
		}
		if (j + 1 <= Main.maxTilesY - 1)
		{
			Tile tile2 = Main.tile[i, j + 1];
			if (tile2 != null && (tile2.wall > 0 || (tile2.active() && TileID.Sets.TruncatesWalls[tile2.type])) && (flag || !tile2.invisibleWall()))
			{
				num |= 8;
			}
		}
		int num2 = 0;
		if (Main.wallLargeFrames[tile.wall] == 1)
		{
			num2 = phlebasTileFrameNumberLookup[j % 4][i % 3] - 1;
			tile.wallFrameNumber((byte)num2);
		}
		else if (Main.wallLargeFrames[tile.wall] == 2)
		{
			num2 = lazureTileFrameNumberLookup[i % 2][j % 2] - 1;
			tile.wallFrameNumber((byte)num2);
		}
		else if (resetFrame)
		{
			num2 = WorldGen.genRand.Next(0, 3);
			if (tile.wall == 21 && WorldGen.genRand.Next(2) == 0)
			{
				num2 = 2;
			}
			tile.wallFrameNumber((byte)num2);
		}
		else
		{
			num2 = tile.wallFrameNumber();
		}
		if (num == 15)
		{
			num += centerWallFrameLookup[i % 3][j % 3];
		}
		Point16 point = wallFrameLookup[num][num2];
		tile.wallFrameX(point.X);
		tile.wallFrameY(point.Y);
	}

	public static Tile GetTileSafely(Vector2 position)
	{
		position /= 16f;
		return GetTileSafely((int)position.X, (int)position.Y);
	}

	public static Tile GetTileSafely(Point pt)
	{
		return GetTileSafely(pt.X, pt.Y);
	}

using System;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.ID;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes;

public class MarbleBiome : MicroBiome
{
	private delegate bool SlabState(int x, int y, int scale);

	private static class SlabStates
	{
		public static bool Empty(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public static bool Solid(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public static bool HalfBrick(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return y >= scale / 2;
		}

		public static bool BottomRightFilled(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return x >= scale - y;
		}

		public static bool BottomLeftFilled(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return x < y;
		}

		public static bool TopRightFilled(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return x > y;
		}

		public static bool TopLeftFilled(int x, int y, int scale)
		{
			return x < scale - y;
		}
	}

	private struct Slab
	{
		public readonly SlabState State;

		public readonly bool HasWall;

		public bool IsSolid => State != new SlabState(SlabStates.Empty);

		private Slab(SlabState state, bool hasWall)
		{
			State = state;
			HasWall = hasWall;
		}

		public Slab WithState(SlabState state)
		{
			return new Slab(state, HasWall);
		}

		public static Slab Create(SlabState state, bool hasWall)
		{
			return new Slab(state, hasWall);
		}
	}

	private const int SCALE = 3;

	private void SmoothSlope(int x, int y)
	{

		if (slab.IsSolid)

			bool isSolid = _slabs[x, y - 1].IsSolid;
			bool isSolid2 = _slabs[x, y + 1].IsSolid;
			bool isSolid3 = _slabs[x - 1, y].IsSolid;
			bool isSolid4 = _slabs[x + 1, y].IsSolid;
			switch (((isSolid ? 1 : 0) << 3) | ((isSolid2 ? 1 : 0) << 2) | ((isSolid3 ? 1 : 0) << 1) | (isSolid4 ? 1 : 0))
			{
			case 10:
				_slabs[x, y] = slab.WithState(SlabStates.TopLeftFilled);
				break;
			case 9:
				_slabs[x, y] = slab.WithState(SlabStates.TopRightFilled);
				break;
			case 6:
				_slabs[x, y] = slab.WithState(SlabStates.BottomLeftFilled);
				break;
			case 5:
				_slabs[x, y] = slab.WithState(SlabStates.BottomRightFilled);
				break;
			case 4:
				_slabs[x, y] = slab.WithState(SlabStates.HalfBrick);
				break;
			default:
				_slabs[x, y] = slab.WithState(SlabStates.Solid);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	private void PlaceSlab(Slab slab, int originX, int originY, int scale)
	{
		ushort num = 367;
		ushort wall = 178;
		if (WorldGen.drunkWorldGen)
		{
			num = 368;
			wall = 180;
		}
		int num2 = -1;
		int num3 = scale + 1;
		int num4 = 0;
		int num5 = scale;
		for (int i = num2; i < num3; i++)
		{
			if ((i == num2 || i == num3 - 1) && WorldGen.genRand.Next(2) == 0)
			{
				continue;
			}
			if (WorldGen.genRand.Next(2) == 0)
			{
				num4--;
			}
			if (WorldGen.genRand.Next(2) == 0)
			{
				num5++;
			}
			for (int j = num4; j < num5; j++)
			{
				Tile tile = GenBase._tiles[originX + i, originY + j];
				tile.ResetToType(TileID.Sets.Ore[tile.type] ? tile.type : num);
				bool active = slab.State(i, j, scale);
				tile.active(active);
				if (slab.HasWall)
				{
					tile.wall = wall;
				}
				WorldUtils.TileFrame(originX + i, originY + j, frameNeighbors: true);
				WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(originX + i, originY + j);
				Tile.SmoothSlope(originX + i, originY + j);
				if (WorldGen.SolidTile(originX + i, originY + j - 1) && GenBase._random.Next(4) == 0)
				{
					WorldGen.PlaceTight(originX + i, originY + j);
				}
				if (WorldGen.SolidTile(originX + i, originY + j) && GenBase._random.Next(4) == 0)
				{
					WorldGen.PlaceTight(originX + i, originY + j - 1);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private static bool IsGroupSolid(int x, int y, int scale)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < scale; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < scale; j++)
			{
				if (WorldGen.SolidOrSlopedTile(x + i, y + j))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
		}
		return num > scale / 4 * 3;
	}

	public override bool Place(Point origin, StructureMap structures, GenerationProgress progress)
	{
		if (WorldGen.BiomeTileCheck(origin.X, origin.Y))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (_slabs == null)
		{
			_slabs = new Slab[56, 26];
		}
		int num = GenBase._random.Next(80, 150) / 3;
		int num2 = GenBase._random.Next(40, 60) / 3;
		int num3 = (num2 * 3 - GenBase._random.Next(20, 30)) / 3;
		origin.X -= num * 3 / 2;
		origin.Y -= num2 * 3 / 2;
		for (int i = -1; i < num + 1; i++)
		{
			double num4 = (double)(i - num / 2) / (double)num + 0.5;
			int num5 = (int)((0.5 - Math.Abs(num4 - 0.5)) * 5.0) - 2;
			for (int j = -1; j < num2 + 1; j++)
			{
				bool hasWall = true;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = IsGroupSolid(i * 3 + origin.X, j * 3 + origin.Y, 3);
				int num6 = Math.Abs(j - num2 / 2) - num3 / 4 + num5;
				if (num6 > 3)
				{
					flag = flag2;
					hasWall = false;
				}
				else if (num6 > 0)
				{
					flag = j - num2 / 2 > 0 || flag2;
					hasWall = j - num2 / 2 < 0 || num6 <= 2;
				}
				else if (num6 == 0)
				{
					flag = GenBase._random.Next(2) == 0 && (j - num2 / 2 > 0 || flag2);
				}
				if (Math.Abs(num4 - 0.5) > 0.35 + GenBase._random.NextDouble() * 0.1 && !flag2)
				{
					hasWall = false;
					flag = false;
				}
				_slabs[i + 1, j + 1] = Slab.Create(flag ? new SlabState(SlabStates.Solid) : new SlabState(SlabStates.Empty), hasWall);
			}
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
		{
			for (int l = 0; l < num2; l++)
			{
				SmoothSlope(k + 1, l + 1);
			}
		}
		int num7 = num / 2;
		int num8 = num2 / 2;
		int num9 = (num8 + 1) * (num8 + 1);
		double value = GenBase._random.NextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0;
		double num10 = GenBase._random.NextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0;
		double value2 = GenBase._random.NextDouble() * 2.0 - 1.0;
		double num11 = 0.0;
		for (int m = 0; m <= num; m++)
		{
			double num12 = (double)num8 / (double)num7 * (double)(m - num7);
			int num13 = Math.Min(num8, (int)Math.Sqrt(Math.Max(0.0, (double)num9 - num12 * num12)));
			num11 = ((m >= num / 2) ? (num11 + Utils.Lerp(num10, value2, (double)m / (double)(num / 2) - 1.0)) : (num11 + Utils.Lerp(value, num10, (double)m / (double)(num / 2))));
			for (int n = num8 - num13; n <= num8 + num13; n++)
			{
				PlaceSlab(_slabs[m + 1, n + 1], m * 3 + origin.X, n * 3 + origin.Y + (int)num11, 3);
			}
		}
		structures.AddStructure(new Rectangle(origin.X, origin.Y, num * 3, num2 * 3), 8);
		return true;
	}
}

	{
		if (applyToNeighbors)
		{
			SmoothSlope(x + 1, y, applyToNeighbors: false, sync);
			SmoothSlope(x - 1, y, applyToNeighbors: false, sync);
			SmoothSlope(x, y + 1, applyToNeighbors: false, sync);
			SmoothSlope(x, y - 1, applyToNeighbors: false, sync);
		}
		Tile tile = Main.tile[x, y];
		if (!WorldGen.CanPoundTile(x, y) || !WorldGen.SolidOrSlopedTile(x, y))
		{
			return;
		}
		bool flag = !WorldGen.TileEmpty(x, y - 1);
		bool flag2 = !WorldGen.SolidOrSlopedTile(x, y - 1) && flag;
		bool flag3 = WorldGen.SolidOrSlopedTile(x, y + 1);
		bool flag4 = WorldGen.SolidOrSlopedTile(x - 1, y);
		bool flag5 = WorldGen.SolidOrSlopedTile(x + 1, y);

			tile.halfBrick(halfBrick: false);

			break;

			tile.halfBrick(halfBrick: true);

// 每 pass 末全网格 FNV 四哈希探针（终极真值链）。
// 挂 WorldGenerator.RunPass 尾（GenerationProgress.End() 之后、GenPassResult 构造前，
//   即 RandNext 抽骰之前——Main.rand 态 = 纯 ApplyPass 末态）。
// 算法与 tools/golden/caves-oracle.cs 的 Checkpoint()/StreamHash() 逐字节一致：
//   typ: act!=0 ? type : 0 → Fnv16（低字节先、一次 xor+mul 每字节）
//   act: Fnv8（每字节 xor+mul 再补一次纯 mul）
//   wal: wall → Fnv16；liq: liquid → Fnv8
//   gho: act==0 ? type : 0 → Fnv16（幽灵 parity 侧车）
//   stream: Main.rand(=WorldGen.genRand) SeedArray[56]+inext 的 FNV（同 oracle StreamHash）
// 遍历序 = oracle 的行主序 i = y*W + x（y 外层 x 内层）。
using System;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding
{
    public static class PassChainProbe
    {
        private static string _path;
        private static bool _header;
        private static int _idx;
        private static FieldInfo _fiSeedArray;
        private static FieldInfo _fiInext;
        private static long _totalMs;

        public static void EvilSetup()
        {
            try
            {
                string e = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_EVIL");
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(e))
                {
                    int v = int.Parse(e);
                    Terraria.WorldGen.WorldGenParam_Evil = v;
                    File.AppendAllText(DumpPath(), "#evil-forced " + v + "\n");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Mark("#evil-ex " + ex.GetType().Name + ": " + ex.Message); }
        }

        private static string DumpPath()
        {
            if (_path == null)
            {
                _path = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_PASSCHAIN");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_path)) _path = "/tmp/sw-num4/home/passchain_default.txt";
            }
            return _path;
        }

        public static void Tail(GenPass pass)
        {
            try
            {
                Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                int W = Terraria.Main.maxTilesX, H = Terraria.Main.maxTilesY;
                Terraria.Tile[,] tile = Terraria.Main.tile;
                uint hT = 2166136261u, hA = 2166136261u, hW = 2166136261u, hL = 2166136261u, hG = 2166136261u;
                int n = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
                {
                    int rowBase = y * W;
                    for (int x = 0; x < W; x++)
                    {
                        Terraria.Tile t = tile[x, y];
                        bool act = t.active();
                        ushort typ = act ? t.type : (ushort)0;
                        uint lo = (uint)(typ & 0xFF);
                        uint hi = (uint)(typ >> 8);
                        hT = (hT ^ lo) * 16777619u;
                        hT = (hT ^ hi) * 16777619u;
                        byte a = act ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                        hA = (hA ^ a) * 16777619u;
                        hA = hA * 16777619u;
                        ushort wv = t.wall;
                        lo = (uint)(wv & 0xFF);
                        hi = (uint)(wv >> 8);
                        hW = (hW ^ lo) * 16777619u;
                        hW = (hW ^ hi) * 16777619u;
                        byte l = t.liquid;
                        hL = (hL ^ l) * 16777619u;
                        hL = hL * 16777619u;
                        ushort gho = act ? (ushort)0 : t.type;
                        lo = (uint)(gho & 0xFF);
                        hi = (uint)(gho >> 8);
                        hG = (hG ^ lo) * 16777619u;
                        hG = (hG ^ hi) * 16777619u;
                        n++;
                    }
                }
                sw.Stop();
                _totalMs += sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                DumpGrids(pass.Name, W, H, tile);
                string line = "P|" + (_idx++) + "|" + pass.Name + "|" +
                    Hex(hT) + " " + Hex(hA) + " " + Hex(hW) + " " + Hex(hL) + "|" +
                    Hex(hG) + "|" + StreamHash() + "|" +
                    Terraria.WorldGen.WorldGenParam_Evil + "," + (Terraria.WorldGen.crimson ? 1 : 0) + "|" +
                    sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + "ms/" + _totalMs + "ms|n=" + n;
                if (!_header)
                {
                    _header = true;
                    string head = "#passchain";
                    try
                    {
                        head += " seed=" + Terraria.Main.ActiveWorldFileData.Seed +
                                " seedText=" + Terraria.Main.ActiveWorldFileData.SeedText +
                                " W=" + Terraria.Main.maxTilesX + " H=" + Terraria.Main.maxTilesY;
                    }
                    catch { }
                    File.AppendAllText(DumpPath(), head + "\n");
                }
                File.AppendAllText(DumpPath(), line + "\n");
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Mark("#tail-ex " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message + "\n" + e.StackTrace);
            }
        }

    var dstType = ImportProbeType(mod, probeDll, "Terraria.GameContent.Biomes", "TerrainProbe");
    var enterRef = dstType.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "Enter");
    var colRef = dstType.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "Col");

    var ip = applyPass.Body.GetILProcessor();
    var first = applyPass.Body.Instructions[0];
    ip.InsertBefore(first, ip.Create(OpCodes.Call, enterRef));

    var body = applyPass.Body;
    var injected = 0;
    for (int idx = 0; idx < body.Instructions.Count; idx++)
    {
        var cur = body.Instructions[idx];
        if (cur.OpCode.Code != Code.Call || cur.Operand is not MethodReference mr || mr.Name != "FillColumn") continue;
        static bool IsLdloc(OpCode op) => op.Code is Code.Ldloc or Code.Ldloc_0 or Code.Ldloc_1 or Code.Ldloc_2 or Code.Ldloc_3 or Code.Ldloc_S;
        var push = new List<Instruction>();
        for (int k = idx - 1; k >= 0 && push.Count < 3 && IsLdloc(body.Instructions[k].OpCode); k--)
            push.Add(body.Instructions[k]);
        push.Reverse();
        if (push.Count != 3) { Console.WriteLine($"[skip] IL_{cur.Offset:X4}: 非 [ldloc x3] 形态（push={push.Count}）"); continue; }
        var slots = push.Select(p => p.Slot()).ToArray();
        Console.WriteLine($"[inject] IL_{cur.Offset:X4} <- Col(V{slots[0]}, V{slots[1]}, V{slots[2]})");
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Ldloc, body.Variables[slots[0]]));
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Ldloc, body.Variables[slots[1]]));
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Ldloc, body.Variables[slots[2]]));
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Call, colRef));
        injected++;
        idx += 4;
    }
    if (injected == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("no FillColumn call site injected");
}

// 跨模块拷贝方法体：操作数令牌全部经 ImportReference 重定；同类型内成员指向克隆后的目标
static void CopyBody(MethodDefinition src, MethodDefinition dst, ModuleDefinition target, TypeDefinition srcType, TypeDefinition dstType)
{
    var map = new Dictionary<Instruction, Instruction>();
    dst.Body.InitLocals = src.Body.InitLocals;
    foreach (var v in src.Body.Variables)
        dst.Body.Variables.Add(new VariableDefinition(target.ImportReference(v.VariableType)));
    foreach (var ins in src.Body.Instructions)
    {
        Instruction ni;
        switch (ins.Operand)
        {
            case Instruction: ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Nop)); break;
            case Instruction[]: ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, new[] { Instruction.Create(OpCodes.Nop) }); break;
            case MethodReference m:
                ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, m.DeclaringType == srcType
                    ? dstType.Methods.First(x => x.Name == m.Name && x.Parameters.Count == m.Parameters.Count)
                    : target.ImportReference(m));
                break;
            case FieldReference f:
                ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, f.DeclaringType == srcType
                    ? dstType.Fields.First(x => x.Name == f.Name)
                    : target.ImportReference(f));
                break;
            case TypeReference t: ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, target.ImportReference(t)); break;
            case VariableReference v: ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, dst.Body.Variables[v.Index]); break;
            case ParameterReference p: ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, dst.Parameters[p.Index]); break;
            default:
                if (ins.Operand == null) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode);
                else if (ins.Operand is string s) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, s);
                else if (ins.Operand is int n4) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, n4);
                else if (ins.Operand is sbyte sb) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, sb);
                else if (ins.Operand is long l4) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, l4);
                else if (ins.Operand is double d4) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, d4);
                else if (ins.Operand is float f4) ni = Instruction.Create(ins.OpCode, f4);
                else throw new NotSupportedException($"operand {ins.Operand.GetType().Name} for {ins.OpCode}");
                break;
        }
        map[ins] = ni;
        dst.Body.Instructions.Add(ni);
    }
    var srcList = src.Body.Instructions;
    for (int k = 0; k < srcList.Count; k++)
    {
        var ni = dst.Body.Instructions[k];
        switch (srcList[k].Operand)
        {
            case Instruction t: ni.Operand = map[t]; break;
            case Instruction[] arr: ni.Operand = arr.Select(a => map[a]).ToArray(); break;
        }
    }
    foreach (var eh in src.Body.ExceptionHandlers)
        dst.Body.ExceptionHandlers.Add(new ExceptionHandler(eh.HandlerType)
        {
            TryStart = map[eh.TryStart],
            TryEnd = eh.TryEnd != null ? map[eh.TryEnd] : null,
            FilterStart = eh.FilterStart != null ? map[eh.FilterStart] : null,
            HandlerStart = eh.HandlerStart != null ? map[eh.HandlerStart] : null,
            HandlerEnd = eh.HandlerEnd != null ? map[eh.HandlerEnd] : null,
            CatchType = eh.CatchType != null ? target.ImportReference(eh.CatchType) : null
        });
}

static class Ext
{
    public static int Slot(this Instruction ldloc) => ldloc.OpCode.Code switch
    {
        Code.Ldloc_0 => 0, Code.Ldloc_1 => 1, Code.Ldloc_2 => 2, Code.Ldloc_3 => 3,
        Code.Ldloc_S or Code.Ldloc => ((VariableReference)ldloc.Operand!).Index,
        _ => -1
    };
}

return; }\n    if (!st.flags[a] || !st.flags[b] || st.type[b] !== st.type[a]) flag3 = true;\n    if (st.frameX[b]! !== st.frameX[a]!) flag3 = true;\n    if (!flag3 && !updateStalagtiteStyle(st, rng, x, num)) flag3 = true;\n    if (flag3) { killStalactiteTile(st, rng, x, num); killStalactiteTile(st, rng, x, num + 1); }\n    return;\n  }\n  // 垂挂双格（frameY 0/18）\n  let num = j;\n  if (st.frameY[i0] === 18) num--;\n  let flag4 = !solidTileSlope(st, x, num - 1);\n  const a = st.inBounds(x, num) ? st.idx(x, num) : -1;\n  const b = st.inBounds(x, num + 1) ? st.idx(x, num + 1) : -1;\n  if (a < 0 || b < 0) { killStalactiteTile(st, rng, x, num); return; }\n  if (!st.flags[a] || !st.flags[b] || st.type[b] !== st.type[a]) flag4 = true;\n  if (st.frameX[b]! !== st.frameX[a]!) flag4 = true;\n  if (!flag4 && !updateStalagtiteStyle(st, rng, x, num)) flag4 = true;\n  if (flag4) { killStalactiteTile(st, rng, x, num); killStalactiteTile(st, rng, x, num + 1); }\n}\n\n/** WorldGen.TileFrame 生成期对 frameImportant 的唯一实际行为（case 165）：\n *  TileFrameImportant → CheckStalactite（cs:85995）。非 165/非活性无操作。 */\nexport function frame165(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {\n  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;\n  const i = st.idx(x, y);\n  if (!st.flags[i]) return;\n  if ((TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1) === 165) checkStalactite(st, rng, x, y);\n}\"\"\")\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nprint('ok')\nPYEOF\ngrep -n \"genSolidType\" src/world/gen/vanilla/ShimmerPass.ts | head -3",
